parsed.post: Kept MATRIX_LR=0.04 at DEPTH=8 (val_bpb 0.9884 -> 0.9865). Stability seems to be paying off. Next, I'll test increasing capacity via DEPTH=12 while maintaining this more stable learning rate to see if depth and lower LR work well together.
parsed.description: Increasing DEPTH from 8 to 12 while keeping the stabilized MATRIX_LR=0.04 to see if increased capacity with a lower learning rate improves val_bpb.
